dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: You two! We've got a problem!

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: An unidentified man came quietly into the store, leaving a package and a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: The man said in his letter that he had heard about our charity sale, and remembered his financial hardships as a child. He was very touched.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: He wanted every child to grow up happy, so he donated some Fairbrew Jelly and other goods for sale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the first time this has happened to us! Paimon's a little moved...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... why would he hide his identity?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe this guy has a low profile! Perhaps, doing good deeds without leaving a name also gives a special sense of accomplishment?

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Maybe we should be more prudent...

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: I have heard that Treasure Hoarders have mixed counterfeit goods with ordinary goods for unsuspecting merchants to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: This way, they can successfully throw away the hot potato, and make Mora on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe it! Those horrible Treasure Hoarders, how can they even cheat innocent shop owners and customers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's suddenly a little nervous... {NICKNAME}, what do you think we should do with the package...
